cards.title: Error spike in hour 14
cards.detail: Hour 14 had 1,460 errors out of 9,225 requests (15.8% error rate), while all other hours had 31 errors each. This spike needs investigation.

cards.title: Model-epsilon 100% error rate
cards.detail: Model-epsilon had 40 requests and 40 errors (100% error rate) with $0 spend. This model is completely failing.

cards.title: Caller-07 high cost per request
cards.detail: Caller-07 spent $174.12 on 1,180 requests, costing $0.1475 per request, which is 9 times the average of $0.0164 per request. Investigate pricing or usage.

cards.title: Caller-01 dominates usage
cards.detail: Caller-01 made 105,832 requests (51.6% of total) and spent $1,643.86 (49% of total). This single caller dominates usage.

cards.title: Low cache hit rates for many callers
cards.detail: 10 callers have cache hit rates below 10%, including caller-07 at 4% and caller-21 at 3.7%. Low cache efficiency may increase costs and latency.

cards.title: Caller-22 expensive single request
cards.detail: Caller-22 made 1 request costing $3.10, which is 189 times the average request cost. Verify if this is a legitimate usage.
